entries.test: Public training results comparing observed gains from additional data and compute with previously established scaling-law predictions would show whether those laws retained their predictive accuracy.
entries.note: The central assertion concerns an observed breakdown in scaling predictability, with a claimed implication for new approaches.

entries.test: Public evaluations and generated videos from the models available by December 11, 2024, including that week's Sora release, would establish whether object-permanence problems persisted across them.
entries.note: The claim concerns models available when the post was published, not every future model.

entries.test: Public engineering case studies documenting measurable improvements achieved without identifying the system's problems or weak points would refute the asserted necessary condition.
entries.note: This asserts a necessary condition for engineering improvement, rather than merely recommending that engineers diagnose problems.
